title: Rationality Check! Benchmarking the Rationality of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using scenario-based tasks and questionnaires from cognitive science to assess belief bias, bias blind spot, hindsight bias, illusion of control, and regret aversion.

Evaluated through tasks adapted from psychological research, testing susceptibility to heuristics and biases such as the availability heuristic, base-rate neglect, confirmation bias, conjunction fallacy, and framing effect.
Assessed using behavioral economics tasks to measure the endowment effect, sunk cost fallacy, gambler's fallacy, mental accounting, and regression to the mean.
